title: Palindrome
author: Andries J. Greyling
rationale: Chamber-piece stand-alone (novel written before the screenplay). Afrikaans is the home register for a South African chamber piece that names Grahamstown, Loubser 1981, and the actuary's cold arithmetic. The Afrikaans edition is a full prose translation of the novella. The stage adaptation ships separately as Palindroom Toneelstuk.

targets.name: Afrikaans
directives: Voice: literary contemporary Afrikaans — quiet, adult, chamber-piece register. Close to the English's clinical dread and humane stillness. NOT stiff textbook, SABC/broadcast, or slangy urban Afrikaans.
This is a FULL PROSE translation of the English novella (seven chapters + dedication + reader note). Preserve every beat of the disclosure staircase. Do NOT convert it into a play or screenplay.
Proper names stay verbatim (see GLOSSARY_PRESERVE): August Renner, Solomon Voss / Sol, Earl Cade, Danny Reiss, Grahamstown, Loubser, Jerome Bixby, The Man from Earth.
Keep the interiority in Voss's POV — free-indirect thought stays as thought, not stage direction.
Do NOT add translator's notes, footnotes, or inline glosses. Preserve all markdown structure and headings (Dedication, A Note to the Reader, One…Seven).
Title of the book in Afrikaans metadata may be rendered as Palindroom where a title line appears; chapter headings One–Seven may become Een–Sewe.
